name: sherlock-ai-plugin
description: Research & Implementation Supercharged with a curated list of AI skills for academic paper analysis, code generation, comic creation, visual schemas, and deep research.

interface.shortDescription: Turn papers into articles, code, comics, and visual schemas
interface.longDescription: A research toolkit: analyze academic papers into in-depth technical articles, convert papers into runnable code, generate educational comics and visual schemas, produce format-controlled deep-research reports, and generate images through Gemini web.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this arXiv paper and write a technical article with formulas
Convert this paper into runnable code
Create an educational comic explaining this paper
